metadata.title: 6-Year Financial History for Golf-Related Listed Companies
metadata.scope: FY2020-FY2025 audited data for IDX/NYSE/SGX listed parents of Indonesian golf operating companies. Peer Group v2 (Cycle 168): 4-tier framework, 13 peer with direct golf operation
metadata.currency_notes: All revenue/profit/asset figures in fiscal-year native currency. Non-IDR tickers (AMMN/FCX/B58) include _idr_equiv at year-end BI rates (2020=14050, 2021=14252, 2022=15592, 2023=15397, 2024=16157).

peer_group_v2.rationale: 관리 관점 — 골프 운영 직접 보유 + 비교 가치 기준 재편. MKPI(0 golf) + BKDP(defunct) + BKSL(관계사 운영) + DILD(segment X) 4 peer 제거 + CTRA·ELTY·LPKR·PWON 4 peer 추가

tier_2_group_with_golf_segment_disclosed.definition: AR에서 골프 segment 매출·비용 별도 라인 공시

tier_4_property_group_with_golf_operatio.definition: 메인 사업은 부동산이나 1개 이상 운영 골프장 보유

removal_reasons.MKPI: PIPG 0.38% associate만 외 0 골프 — Cycle 102 verified no Golf segment
removal_reasons.BKDP: CORRECTIONS #10: 매출 = 쇼핑센터 임대. Bukit Darmo Golf 사실상 비활성
